question: How does a body purified by śakti-nyāsa relate to gods and demons?
premises: The body is purified by śakti-nyāsa.
Gods and demons are invoked in this context.
The purified body is the locus of this power.
inference: Through a body purified by śakti-nyāsa, gods and demons are encompassed or addressed.
uncertainties: The verb governing surāsurāḥ is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: By a body purified through the placement of śakti, O gods and demons.
